caption: The worked example drawn as two unfolded steps: h₀ = 0 and x₁ = 1 give h₁ = tanh(1.000) = 0.76, then x₂ = 2 and h₁ give h₂ = tanh(2.3808) = 0.98 and y₂ = 0.98. Both arrows marked ×0.5 carry the same recurrent weight W_hh, so the extra step adds no new parameters.
